title: Staging-local MariaDB 11.4 class-level SHA2 ordinary-column trigger compatibility

phases.objective: Prevent every currently identified MariaDB 11.4 SHA2-generated-column ERROR 1901 path by materializing the affected digest columns as ordinary columns and maintaining them through exact DDL-defined BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE triggers, while preserving immutable historical migrations and schema contracts.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed CI and staging-local Windows migration operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact-head static governance followed by a freshly authorized disposable Windows Docker MariaDB 11.4 schema-only replay
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The ordered guard detects all known SHA2-generated columns, accepts only five exact ordinary-column trigger bridges, reports zero unsupported expressions, and any later local replay stops before AutoPilot, importer, readback, deployment, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, or Production action on the first MariaDB error.
steps: Discover and register all known SHA2-generated-column compatibility bridges in the immutable ordered migration chain.

Verify each bridge is ordered before its historical writer, DDL-only, preserves affected table keys and foreign keys, and declares exact ordinary type/nullability and BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE trigger expressions.
Run static generated-column, pre-use, collation, enum, text-width, index-width, required-INSERT, builder, and governance checks on the exact source head.
After a fresh merged main head and a new exact-SHA authorization, run only the disposable local Windows Docker MariaDB 11.4 schema-only replay.
Stop before AutoPilot, importer, readback, data export/import, deployment, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, or Production operations on any failure.
assertions: The forbidden generated-expression function denylist includes SHA2 and the guard fails closed when a matching ordered bridge is absent, malformed, or incomplete.
The five known SHA2 columns use ordinary materialized columns with exact type/nullability contracts and named BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE triggers; ordinary columns are not counted as generated_columns.
All five bridges are DDL-only, preserve source affected-table indexes and foreign keys, and leave immutable historical migration SQL unchanged.

The plan and governance report expose generated_columns, generated_expression_checks, compatibility_bridge_candidates, unsupported_generated_expressions, allowed_compatibility_bridges, and ordinary_column_trigger_bridges.
No database, provider, credential, export, runtime, deployment, Production, AutoPilot, importer, or readback mutation is introduced by static governance or this declaration.
production_mutation_allowed is false and secrets_included is false.
